correctness.rationale: The degree-ell harmonic space comprises the matrix coefficients of Sym^ell(C^2); Schur orthogonality for Haar probability introduces the factor ell+1 in the kernel. Even ell descends to A5 regardless of antipodal representative. The class weights 1,15,20,12,12 and half-angles 0, pi/2, pi/3, pi/5, 2pi/5 give the stated restricted character. Schur orthogonality on the unweighted target gives sector dimension d_rho^2 and convolution scalar 60(ell+1)m_rho/d_rho. The kernel projectors and pseudoinverse correctly give the range and the unique minimum-norm interpolant. The nonidentity characters repeat under ell+60 and the identity increment adds one regular character, giving the permanent full rank from 60. An independent exact Chebyshev recurrence in Z[phi], `python3 /workspace/branches/replay_2_3.py`, gives both rank tables, first rank 60 at 20 and last deficiency at 58; the latter has multiplicities (0,3,3,4,5). Rank 59 loses only the trivial sector. Equal remaining sector eigenvalues make the restricted character constant away from the identity; by the angle residues this is possible only in degree 0 or 58 modulo 60. Only 58 is rank 59, and its character is 59 at the identity and -1 elsewhere, making G=3540 I-59*11*. Bounded nonidentity character values prove the stated conditioning estimate; the nonzero entry at perpendicular lines excludes exact full orthogonality. The frozen checker was inspected, not executed.

originality.rationale: A distinct indexed record, 13f75a70c530, determines the exact-degree Gram spectrum and ranks on all 120 vertices for both parities, including the equal 59 positive values at 58. Even-degree antipodal compression with the source-norm rescaling yields this frozen spectrum, including the five sectors, and the later inspected parity-sharp record also gives the conditioning rate. The rank-59 uniqueness and reconstruction statements then follow mechanically. This is a finding of demonstrable equivalent coverage, not a claim that the later-dated catalogue labels establish historical precedence. The unavailable 1974 text is not the basis for failure.
residual_risks: Historical publication priority is not settled by catalogue timestamps. The full Backhouse–Gard article was not accessible and may have useful older equivalent calculations.
The frozen cumulative-band comparator lacked a bibliographic locator; in any event band surjectivity alone would not imply exact-degree surjectivity.
